insurer_note: Prudential's own Kenya website could not be fetched (not on the session allowlist; the plak.pages.dev mirror returned unrelated content), so most detail is from secondary sources and Standard Chartered Kenya bancassurance pages (SC distributes Prudential products and names Prudential Life Assurance Kenya as underwriter). Pru Dahari-Dumu, Pru Select and PruMemorial come from a third-party blog (victormatara.com), unverified against the insurer. Most numeric terms are not published in what was fetched.

products.name: LivLife
products.summary: Large-value, needs-based whole-life cover for affluent clients, sold through Standard Chartered; critical illness and disability benefits, legacy planning; cover up to Sh500 million (press).
products.target_client: Affluent individuals; wealth transfer and legacy planning
products.how_it_works: Whole-life style policy; critical illness benefit pays 50% of sum assured (up to KES 15m) with future premiums waived and cover continuing for life.
key_features: Health Protection Benefit: 50% of sum assured up to KES 15m on critical illness diagnosis before 66
Ability Support Plan: 100% of sum assured on permanent disability, premiums waived
Cover up to Sh500m per Capital FM
benefits: Tax relief certificates for terms of 10 years or more
products.term_or_duration: Minimum 10 years for tax relief; otherwise not stated
channels_or_distinct_points: Distributed by Standard Chartered Bancassurance Intermediary; underwritten by Prudential Life Assurance Kenya
Six-month pilot reportedly sold Sh2.6bn sum assured (Capital FM, July 2025)
analysis_selling_points: High-cover needs-based proposition for wealth clients
Living benefits (CI, disability) with premium waiver
Bank channel access to affluent base
analysis_watch_outs: Minimum premium, entry age and exclusions not published
Bank-distributed; high-net-worth focus limits mass-market relevance
products.source_note: SC Kenya page fetched; Capital FM article (https://www.capitalfm.co.ke/business/2025/07/prudential-eyes-affluent-individuals-with-up-to-sh500mn-cover/) fetched for cover limit and pilot.

products.name: Future Ready Plan
products.summary: Savings-oriented plan with life, accidental death, critical illness and disability benefits and staged maturity payouts, sold through Standard Chartered.
products.target_client: Middle to upper-income earners funding children's education, retirement or financial stability
products.how_it_works: Maturity benefits paid in four stages (stages not described); 15-year, KES 2m, age-35 male illustration given on page.
key_features: Unexpected death: double the sum assured
Accidental death: double the sum assured up to KES 150m, premiums waived and maturity benefit paid
Critical illness: 50% of sum assured (page cites both KES 30m and KES 15m caps)
Permanent total disability: 100% of sum assured
benefits: Tax relief certificates for terms of 10 years or more
products.term_or_duration: Minimum 10 years for tax relief; example 15 years
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Medical exam mandatory for covers above KES 15m; exclusions not stated
channels_or_distinct_points: Distributed by Standard Chartered Bancassurance Intermediary; underwritten by Prudential Life Assurance Kenya
analysis_selling_points: Rich bundled protection (double death benefit, CI, TPD)
analysis_watch_outs: Page's critical illness cap is inconsistent (KES 30m vs 15m)
Entry age, minimums, exclusions not published; no monthly option mentioned

products.name: Pru Dahari-Dumu
products.summary: Combined savings and life protection plan; billed as Kenya's first product with a 'Never Lapse Guarantee' (policies beyond six months do not lapse).
products.how_it_works: Savings plus protection; after six months of premiums a premium holiday is possible.
key_features: Never Lapse Guarantee after first six months
analysis_selling_points: Never-lapse feature addresses the biggest persistency fear
analysis_watch_outs: Details (entry age, premium, cover) not published in sources
Source for features is secondary (2018 Standard article and a blog)
products.source_note: Standard (Oct 2018) article fetched; short summary also from victormatara.com. Not verified on Prudential's own site.

products.name: Pru Select
products.summary: Savings plan for goals such as school fees with life protection, a guaranteed savings target and cash payouts in the final years.
products.target_client: People saving for school fees and similar goals
products.how_it_works: Set savings target and term, choose number of cash payouts in final years; pay monthly, quarterly, semi-annually or annually (discount for less frequent).
benefits: Death: 100% of insured amount; 200% for accidental death, with remaining payments continued
Optional critical illness cover 50% of insured amount and permanent disability cover, with payments continued
analysis_selling_points: Guaranteed target with continued payments after death or disability
analysis_watch_outs: Source is a third-party blog; confirm with Prudential
Entry age, premium, exclusions not available
products.source_note: Blog page fetched; not verified on insurer site.

products.name: PruMemorial Family Cover
products.summary: Family cover helping with costs after a death, with funeral, accidental death and disability benefits, plus a lifetime plan with critical illness and TPD.
products.how_it_works: Claims within 48 hours; 50% of annual premium returned every 5 years as a loyalty benefit; lifetime variant includes optional spousal cover.
key_features: Funeral, accidental death and accidental disability benefits
Loyalty benefit 50% of annual premium every 5 years
No medical exam for sums up to KES 5m (lifetime plan)
benefits: Tax relief 15% of premium up to KES 60,000 a year
Doubled accidental death or disability cover (lifetime plan)
analysis_selling_points: Premium-back loyalty benefit is a distinctive hook
analysis_watch_outs: Source is a third-party blog; confirm figures
products.source_note: Blog page fetched; not verified on insurer site.

products.name: Group Last Expense (Funeral) Cover
products.summary: Group funeral cover paying KES 50,000 to 500,000 per member within 48 hours of documents.
products.target_client: Organisations, SACCOs not needing a full group life package
analysis_selling_points: Simple group funeral option for SACCOs
analysis_watch_outs: Third-party source; premiums and exclusions not available
products.source_note: Blog page fetched; not verified on insurer site.
